post_game_reflections.self_assessment: Although I had high hopes going into the game, my leadership failed to achieve its objectives due to my team's poor cooperation and lack of clear strategic planning. In hindsight, I could have been more decisive and proactive in influencing my team members' decisions. Overall, I feel that my leadership failed to live up to my expectations.

player_observations.Bob: Bob's playstyle was stealthy and evasive, making it extremely difficult to discern his actual intentions or allegiance until the game's conclusion. His role as the assassin was well-camouflaged, and I'm impressed by his ability to deceive us so effectively.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was a force to be reckoned with, exhibiting cunning and calculating traits that were detrimental to our mission's success. He seemed to know exactly when to sabotage and disrupt our plans, hinting that he may have been more than just an 'evil' player.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's contributions to our team were invaluable; she was diligent, responsive, and consistently offered sound advice and suggestions. Her unwavering optimism was a welcome presence, and it's clear she was a trusted ally within our group.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's role as Merlin seemed to have a profound impact on our collective success, and her influence was felt throughout the game. Her guidance and strategic input were instrumental in shaping the trajectory of our missions, even if we ultimately failed to capitalize on her advice.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully completed my mission without being detected, but I could have been more aggressive in eliminating potential threats, possibly preventing the good team from gathering more information.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played extremely defensively as a leader, relying heavily on her team for information and failing to take control of the missions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie seemed to be playing cautiously and only acted when he thought it was safe, which ultimately allowed me to complete my missions without raising suspicion.
player_observations.Diana: Diana appeared to be a very cooperative player, trying to help her team by discussing the game's progress and strategies.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was playing the Merlin role effectively, disguising herself as a non-essential player until the end, and then revealing her true identity and attempting to disrupt our plans.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was able to effectively play the role of the evil character without being detected, successfully contributing to the evil team's wins. However, I could improve by finding ways to eliminate the good players more efficiently and reducing the number of FAIL cards used against us in missions. With a bit more subtlety, I could have made our wins even more decisive.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played the role of the leader well, but her tendency to reveal the FAIL cards in missions allowed us to anticipate and prepare for the evil players' actions. She often seemed unsure of her own strengths and weaknesses, which made her an easier target for the assassin.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's performance as the assassin was solid, but he often overplayed his hand, revealing too much information about himself and allowing the good players to adjust their strategy accordingly. His attempts to eliminate the good players were occasionally clumsy and predictable.
player_observations.Diana: Diana seemed to struggle with finding the right balance between contributing to the team's goals and keeping herself safe from the evil players' attacks. Her actions often seemed reactive, rather than proactive, which left her and the team vulnerable to the enemy's plans.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's work as the Merlin was exceptional, as she managed to maintain complete secrecy about her abilities and subtly influenced the team's decisions to our advantage. Her strategic thinking and ability to read the situation were a significant factor in the evil team's success.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was overly reliant on trusting the leader, which ultimately led to my downfall. In hindsight, I should have been more cautious. I will work on developing a more balanced approach to trusting fellow players in future games.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played cautiously, making good decisions but rarely taking bold actions.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was highly effective as the assassin, blending in seamlessly with the good team and making strategic kills. Their ability to stay undercover until the final mission was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's role as the evil member made them somewhat predictable, but their actions were always well-timed and contributed significantly to the team's success.
player_observations.Diana: As I am, myself, I won't comment on my own playstyle, however the rest of the good team would have benefitted from my insight if I'd been more open about my own role.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's strategy as Merlin was to take a backseat, often not participating in discussions or voting until the final stages of a mission. This ambiguity made it difficult for us to pinpoint their true intentions.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, my performance suffered due to underestimating Bob's alignment and over-reliance on Eve's (my own) abilities, which didn't have the desired impact. I struggled to make a timely reveal, and my communication was not effective in the final mission. Improving strategic planning and teamwork coordination are crucial areas for improvement.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played it cautious and kept her alignment hidden until the very end, suggesting she's an experienced player with a good grasp of social engineering.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's cunning played out well as Assassin, using his influence to deceive and eliminate the true Merlin in an attempt to control the narrative and dictate mission results.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a solid Evil role, contributing meaningfully to mission failures and consistently voting against the proposed course of action, demonstrating an understanding of team dynamics and strategic voting.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, the other Good player, made solid contributions but seemed to hesitate in making impactful decisions, hinting at potential room for improvement in her assertiveness and influencing.
